profiles.name: Stephen Held
queries: Stephen Held arrested protest photo ICE
profiles.notes: Independent court declaration, Press Freedom Tracker and Heartland Signal confirm Steve/Stephen Held is the Chicago Unraveled Press cofounder arrested at Broadview September 27, 2025. Official team page offers biography but no individual portrait. Muck Rack profile image downloaded and visually inspected: People's Fabric logo, not a face (tmp/held243.jpg). Award article image downloaded and inspected: plaque and fantasy trading card, not Held (tmp/award243.webp). Heartland lead is AP/Alex Brandon generic officers and protesters, not identified Held. Reject Commons 2010 Senior Airman Stephen Held and Irish WWII Stephen Carroll Held as unlinked namesakes. No crop or deployment. Further named news portraits remain a possible lead.
profiles.rights: No portrait selected. Generic AP photo and logos are not public-domain evidence.
